spanish: Y varón que diere su yacimiento en bestia, de morir morirá, y a la bestia matarán.

findings.issue: Hophal imperfect 3ms (be put to death) is rendered as active morirá (he will die), changing stem force.
Feminine noun of lying (שכב) plus 3ms suffix is rendered yacimiento, which in current Spanish is a mineral or archaeological deposit and does not state the lying.

notes: 2mp matarán is ustedes address; de morir matches the qal infinitive absolute.
